items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:1
items.html: You already know that the upper one always fits its coupling to the measure of the MAN, namely the records of the lower one, that rise to it for the inclusion of the coupling. And it is known that there are two aspects in the records: one is the refined light within them, which is the aspect of direct light, the aspect of the GAR of the records, which remained in Atzilut; and there is also the aspect of coarse light, which are the aspects of the coarseness and the reflected light, called sparks, which are the aspect of the light of Hassadim and HGT, and were able to descend with the vessels to BYA. And the vessels themselves are the NHY in all of them.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:2
items.html: Therefore, in order to correct the vessels, AVI need to clothe in the screen of the aspect of NHY of Katnut, namely the aspect of the Yesod of Tevunah, at the time when they were divided into themselves as a Partzuf separate from upper Ima. And in order to correct the sparks, AVI need to clothe in the screen of HGT of Katnut, which stands at the place of their chest, which is the place of the cut between Ima and Tevunah. You already know that the Yesod of Katnut stands at the aspect of the chest. And in order to correct the aspect of the lights in the records, which are the aspect of GAR, they need the aspect of the GAR of upper Ima from the time of Katnut, from when she was lacking the fiftieth upper gate, as above in Answer 129, see there. And by this the records of direct light, which are the aspect of GAR, are corrected.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:3
items.html: Addendum to Answer 88 Regarding what was said there about the distinction between the male and female Partzufim of Atzilut, one must understand well the two lower Partzufim, MA and BON, of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:4
items.html: Now, the ARI explained them in Etz Chaim, Gate 5, end of Chapter 1, and this is his language: In the internality of AK there is one HaVaYaH, and from its four letters come out four Havayot that are revealed outside of AK, and these are the HaVaYaH of AB, SAG, MA, and BON, and they are in the forehead, AHP; and the fact that the HaVaYaH of BON precedes the HaVaYaH of MA is the secret of the Tefillin of Rabbeinu Tam, and the secret of “a female shall surround a male.” This concludes his words. So the ARI considers the two worlds, Nekudim and Atzilut, to be BON and MA of AK. And these words need explanation, since nothing remained from the world of Nekudim except the GAR that Atik of Atzilut took, while the ZAT broke, front and back; so how did the ten Sefirot of Nekudim become BON of AK, and moreover become the root for its MA, in the secret of “a female shall surround a male”?

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:5
items.html: However, one must remember here the rule that all the lights in the lower one are found, in their essence, in the upper one above it, and in the lower one itself they are only the aspect of a small branch, as is known. Therefore every lower one comes out from the aspect of the lack that is in the upper one, and also completes the lack within it. For those lights that the upper one bestows upon its lower one had already fixed their place in the upper one itself, and therefore they complete it. Hence, after the refining of the Guf of the Partzuf of Keter of AK, when the lights departed from its vessels, AK emanated AB and SAG, so that they would return to fill the lights for the vessels of its Guf; and since AB and SAG were completed at the Tabur, and completed nothing at all to fill it in the whole place from the Tabur down to the ending of its legs, it therefore returned and emanated the ten Sefirot of Nekudim from its Tabur and below, from the lights of the Nikvey Einayim. The aspect of their Rosh and Toch came out in the GAR of Nekudim, in the complete fullness of the correction of the lines; but in the ZAT, only the aspect of the illumination of vessels was reached, from the aspect of the look of the eyes at the AHP below the Shibolet HaZakan, which are the lights of NHY without a correction of the lines, as is known. Because of this, only the lower third of the Tifferet of AK, from its Tabur to the ending of Tifferet, was corrected with three lines; but all its ZAT of NHY, from the ending of its Tifferet and below, remained with only two lines, without the deciding force of the middle line there. It is then considered that AK was completed by itself, through its emanation of the ten Sefirot of Nekudim, only in the aspect of the TNHY of the female alone, namely in two legs, in the lights of Nefesh, lacking a middle line. And although the Katnut of ZAT also broke, face and back, in Nekudim, this does not affect at all the aspect of their root that remained in AK itself for its own completion, as you know from the reason that there is no absence in the spiritual. It is therefore considered that Shabbat was born first, since AK received completion for its NHY from the aspect of a daughter and a female, and this correction remained fixed in it permanently.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 95:6
items.html: Therefore AK emanated the ten Sefirot of Atzilut, in order to correct the ZAT of its NHY. And it is known that the entire ten Sefirot of Atzilut are the aspect of the ZAT of the NHY of AK, which did not receive corrections in the world of Nekudim, as above. Therefore AA begins to clothe from the Peh of RADLA and below, which is below the ending of the Tifferet of AK, since RADLA clothes the entire place of the lower third of the Tifferet of AK, and RADLA does not join Atzilut, as is known; rather, AA is considered the Keter of Atzilut. So the entire world of Atzilut clothes only the ZAT of the NHY of AK, and therefore the five Partzufim of Atzilut are considered only the HGT NHY of AK alone. And it is known that all five Partzufim of Atzilut came at first in the secret of the impregnation of three within three, through which they received the aspect of the joining of the measure of mercy with judgment, since the bottom Hey that was attached to Yesod rose and was included in Tifferet, which is the Bina of the aspect of Hesed and Bina of Hassadim, as is known. It is thus found now that the correction of the lines was also completed in the Toch of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK, namely in the HGT of its NHY. In such a way that, when GAR of Atzilut, namely AA, AVI, and YESHSUT, were emanated, the GAR of the middle line of this Toch were corrected; and when ZAT of Atzilut, namely ZON, were corrected, then the ZAT of the middle line of the Toch of the ten Sefirot of NHY of AK were corrected. Therefore the entire ten Sefirot of Atzilut did not come for AK except to correct the middle line of the Toch of the ten Sefirot of its NHY, called the male Yesod of AK, or Hadar. GAR of Atzilut corrected in it the upper Hadar, and ZAT corrected in it the lower Hadar. And this is what completes the TNHY of AK in the aspect of the five Partzufim of AK, in the secret of the male within it, and it is considered a product of its AB, since it came through the coupling of AB SAG. And you should understand that all of this discussion is from the aspect of the ten Sefirot of Atzilut that are fixed in the NHY of AK itself, on account of the lights of the lower one being found essentially in its upper one. Now you should understand well the rule, that every Partzuf is composed of the five Partzufim GESMB, so that every aspect takes from the corresponding Partzuf in the five Partzufim of AK. You should also understand that the female Partzufim of Atzilut, being entirely only from BON of AK, have no deciding force of a middle line in the Toch of their NHY, since even in AK they are lacking. But all the male Partzufim of Atzilut have the aspect of a Toch in their NHY, since they receive from the corresponding aspect from MA of AK, which has the deciding force of a middle line in the Toch of its NHY. You should also understand that MA is caused by BON, in the secret of “a female shall surround a male,” since in the particulars of AK itself, BON came out first, and it completed the GAR of NHY; and the MA within it is a branch and product of BON. And BON is considered the aspect of surrounding in relation to MA, by virtue of being its upper one — for the upper one is considered surrounding in relation to the lower one beneath it, as is known.
